units.source_text: 源氏说：“消失在泪海中，这想法未免太幼稚了。

en.t: Genji said, "To vanish into a sea of tears is far too childish an idea.

units.source_text: 那三途川是必经之路，你渡川时，至少让我扶持你的指尖儿吧。”

en.t: The River of Three Crossings is a road everyone must take, so when you cross it, at least let me support the tips of your fingers."
As he said this, he smiled faintly.

units.source_text: 又说：“你现在想必已经明确知道了吧。

en.t: Then he added, "By now you must surely understand quite clearly.

units.source_text: 像我这种诚实无比而又极可信赖的人，实在是世无其类的。

en.t: There is truly no one else in the world as utterly honest and trustworthy as I am.
If you can understand that, I shall be at ease."

units.source_text: 玉鬘听了这话，心中非常难过。

en.t: When Tamakazura heard these words, she felt deeply distressed.

units.source_text: 源氏看她可怜，便把话头转向别处：“皇上盼望你入宫，

en.t: Seeing how pitiful she was, Genji turned the conversation elsewhere: "His Majesty hopes that you will enter court service,
and it would be discourteous for you not to obey.
You really ought to go there at least once.

units.source_text: 女子被丈夫占为己有之后，往往不便兼任公务。

en.t: Once a woman has been claimed by a husband, it is often difficult for her to continue holding public duties as well.

units.source_text: 我当初替你定的计划，本来不是这样的。

en.t: The plan I first made for you was not originally like this.

units.source_text: 可是二条那位内大臣赞成这婚事，我也只得同意了。”

en.t: But the Inner Minister at Nijo approved of this marriage, so I had no choice but to agree as well."
He spoke gently and delicately, continuing on without tiring.

units.source_text: 玉鬘听了又是感动，又是羞耻，只管淌着眼泪，默默不作一声。

en.t: Tamakazura listened, both moved and ashamed, and only let her tears fall, remaining silent without saying a word.

units.source_text: 源氏见她如此伤心，觉得不便任情罄谈衷曲，只把入宫须知之事及事前应有之准备等教导了一番。

en.t: Seeing her so sorrowful, Genji felt it would not do to pour out everything in his heart, and instead instructed her about what she needed to know for entering court and the preparations she should make beforehand.

units.source_text: 看他的模样，不会立刻允许玉鬘迁往髭黑大将邸内。

en.t: From his manner, it did not seem that he would immediately allow Tamakazura to move into General Higekuro's residence.
